messages.message:
Patch Set 4:

(3 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Mostly good. The change is verifiably a no-op: a token-level comparison of every touched file against the parent shows only equivalent substitutions (unsigned -> unsigned int, S_IRWXUGO -> 0777, S_IRUGO|S_IWUSR -> 0644, __attribute__((packed)) -> __packed, dropped '= 0' on a file-scope int) plus one added space inside a format string, and no format-string content drift anywhere else. Net checkpatch count over the twelve files drops from 590 to 287. A few of the message-string reflows came out worse than what they replaced; comments inline.
